title: Smart App Control blocks the execution of mRemoteNG
author: dewidh
body_snippet: First of all, thank you for your work maintaining this application. I use a laptop with a Snapdragon X Elite cpu with Windows 11 ARM, I downloaded the ARM version, I trid both he Self Contained and the Framework Dependant, the first time it executed right, but when I tried the second time I receive a message from the Smart App Control blocking the application, and I can not use it. I would prefer to not turn off Smart App Control for security reasons. Thank you, Dewidh
notes: Smart App Control blocks unsigned ARM64 v1.84.0; no code fix; known limitation README 6.4 row 8; open until signed builds
